The '''Remaster changes list''' records mistakes and rough edges found on published [[Virtual cards]] (and, where they occur, [[Decipher]] cards) that a '''remastered''' printing should fix.

Card articles on this wiki show each card's text exactly as it was published by Decipher or the [[Players Committee]], typos included. It is not the wiki's job to correct a publisher's mistakes, even small ones such as a misspelled word, so the article for a published version keeps "Immue", "traget" or "Epic Even" as printed. Remastered sets are where the wording is cleaned up and corrected: a remaster updates the image and the text so the card is clearer, easier to read and of higher quality. That includes bolding attributes such as '''spy''' or '''smuggler''' for convenience. A card with a typo deserves a remaster. A remaster changes presentation only: it does not change what the card does in play. Where a fix below would change play (for example a sentence missing from one source), it needs a ruling first; the rulings are noted in the row.

Each table lists the card (linked to the article of the published version that shows the problem), the published text or field, the problem, the proposed remaster correction and where the problem was found. The card's article links back here from its Notes section.

== Attributes to bold ==
Some game text names a character's attribute (spy, smuggler, scout, gangster, bounty hunter…) that other cards look for. A remaster bolds that word so a player can find it at a glance. The Original Virtual Set remaster of [[Tamtel Skreej (V) (Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court)]] already bolds "spy". This table is a starting list, not a complete one.
{| class="wikitable sortable"
! Card !! Published text or field !! Problem !! Proposed remaster correction !! Source of the finding
|-
| [[Velken Tezeri (V) (Virtual Block 7)]]
| "[Pilot] 2. Smuggler. May not be attacked."
| The attribute "Smuggler" is plain text
| "[Pilot] 2. '''Smuggler.''' May not be attacked."
| [[Velken Tezeri (V) (Virtual Block 7)]]
|-
| [[Tamtel Skreej (V)]]
| "Deploys only to a Tatooine site as an Undercover spy."
| The attribute "spy" is plain text
| "…as an Undercover '''spy'''."
| [[Tamtel Skreej (V)]]; remaster precedent [[Tamtel Skreej (V) (Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court)]]
|-
| [[Boushh (V) (Virtual Block 9)]]
| "May deploy as an Undercover spy to Coruscant, Tatooine, or same site as a gangster."
| The attribute "spy" is plain text
| "May deploy as an Undercover '''spy'''…"
| [[Boushh (V) (Virtual Block 9)]]
|}
